name: darkest_linear
comment: Linear zone prototype (src/patches/120_linear_zone.py): six of Blizzard's Act I cave rooms in a row, west to east. cavee (a dead end open to the east) is where the player arrives, four east-west tunnel rooms follow, and cavew (a dead end open to the west) holds the boss. The game fills it with its own random monster packs (lvlprest Populate = 1); the plugin spawns the boss when the hero reaches the last room (src/plugin/zone.cpp).
